Naturalistic photographic cinematography, soft overcast daylight after rain in an ordinary public park, muted greens, realistic skin and wet surfaces. Sweet, restrained, observant, never cheesy or sentimental. Consistent characters and wardrobe throughout: a young adult woman in her late twenties with a curly black bob and a yellow raincoat; an older adult man in his seventies with a white beard and blue coat. No dialogue, no music, no sound, no captions or text overlays. Scene 1, seconds 0–5: medium-wide eye-level shot. The young woman walks up to a wet wooden park bench, notices beads of rainwater on the seat, pauses and looks at the wet seat with a small, rueful expression. Scene 2, seconds 5–10: a closer two-shot at the same bench. The older man beside her notices her hesitation and kindly offers his folded newspaper, then lays the folded newspaper flat on the wet seat for her to sit on. Clearly show the simple practical gesture and her small grateful smile. Newspaper remains a recognizable folded paper, not an umbrella or cloth. Scene 3, seconds 10–15: medium-wide shot at the same bench. She sits on the folded newspaper and he sits beside her, with friendly comfortable space between them. They briefly exchange small, genuine smiles, then relax looking out into the park. A quiet moment of neighborly kindness, not romance. Underplayed acting, no exaggerated grins, no hugging, no melodramatic gestures, no slow motion, no flashy camera moves. Maintain the same woman, man, coats, newspaper, bench and park across all three scenes. Finish holding on them seated together."}}
